blends.name: Blaze it Up Achievement (Read Blend Description!)
blends.desc:
# WARNING!
**Ensure you only select NFT's you wish to burn!
Do Not Auto Select!**

**Only burn the following in this blend! **
Coins
Equipment
PvP NFT's
Orbs (Do Not burn Super Orbs)
Events
Passes
Shards
Promo
Chests
Seasonal (excluding seasonal lands and planets)

Burn 99 Box Maze World NFT's to earn the Blaze It Up Common NFT!
Further Blaze It Up rarities will be based on the supply of Common Blaze It Up NFT's, so feel free to mint as many of these as you can.

**Achievement NFT's will earn LAG tokens along with additional benefits within the new platform.
Box Maze World NFT's will become redundant, so if you choose to keep them they will only be collectables**
